query: psycholinguistic features for deceptive role detection in werewolf
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%psycholinguistic%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%psycholinguistic%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%liwc%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%liwc%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%deception%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%deception%' OR p.title ILIKE '%deceptive%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%deceptive%')
  )
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%werewolf%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%werewolf%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%role-playing game%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%role-playing game%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%social deduction%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%social deduction%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%psycholinguistic%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%psycholinguistic%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%deception%' OR p.title ILIKE '%deceptive%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%deception%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%deceptive%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%werewolf%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%werewolf%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: finding word substitutions using a distributional similarity baseline and immediate context overlap
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ to_tsquery('english',
      '("word" & substitution) | ("lexical" & substitution) | ("distributional" & similarity) | ("distributional" & semantics) | ("context" & overlap) | ("context" & similarity) | ("context-sensitive" & substitution) | ("paraphrase" & substitution)'
    )
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%word substitution%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%lexical substitution%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%context-sensitive substitution%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%distributional similarity%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%word substitution%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%lexical substitution%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%context-sensitive substitution%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%distributional similarity%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%context overlap%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    to_tsquery('english',
      '("word" & substitution) | ("lexical" & substitution) | ("distributional" & similarity) | ("distributional" & semantics) | ("context" & overlap) | ("context" & similarity) | ("context-sensitive" & substitution) | ("paraphrase" & substitution)'
    )
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.title,

    plainto_tsquery('english', 'hierarchical & model & reviews & aspect & based & sentiment & analysis')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
